answer_1.quote: Embodied Instruction Following (EIF), where agents must interpret natural language instructions to navigate and act within their environment using egocentric observations...
answer_1.outputs: execution trajectory T = ⟨V 0 , a 0 , V 1 , a 1 , . . . , V T , a T ⟩, where a t is the action taken by the agent at time step t

answer_2.quote: Following , we report four evaluation metrics on AFLRED: (1) Success Rate (SR); (2) Goal Condition (GC), the ratio of goal conditions completed at the end of an episode; (3) path length weighted SR (PLWSR), the SR weighted by (path length of the expert trajectory)/(path length taken by the agent); (4) path length weighted GC (PLWGC), the GC weighted by the same factor.
